# DappGo

> Public Taiwan stocks, US stocks and US options research. Quotes may be delayed; research is informational, not personalized investment advice.

## Reading policy

Public search, reading and citation are permitted. Model training is not permitted. robots.txt declares search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no. These preferences do not enforce access controls or guarantee crawler compliance.

## Public Markdown guide

- [AI reading guide](https://dappgo.com/ai-guide.txt): plain-text Markdown, data identity, freshness and citation instructions

## Canonical latest pointers

- [Taiwan stocks](https://data.dappgo.com/v1/markets/tw/dashboard/latest.json)
- [US stocks](https://data.dappgo.com/v1/markets/us/dashboard/latest.json)
- [US options](https://data.dappgo.com/v1/markets/options/dashboard/latest.json)

Resolve data_url_v2 relative to https://data.dappgo.com/v1/markets/<market>/ (not the pointer's dashboard directory), then check payload data_hash matches pointer hash. Accept only the corresponding dashboard/data-*.json immutable path. Read report_date, schema_version, timestamps and coverage from the payload. HTTP 200 does not establish freshness, complete coverage or live prices. Do not guess immutable filenames or use a moving CDN alias as the primary publication identity.

## Homepage pulse

- [Homepage pulse](https://dappgo.com/data/pulse.json): a compact derived summary (report dates, market regime, five-day movers, top-scored options setups, latest headline links) rebuilt on trading days from the canonical pointers above. Each market entry carries the source `data_hash`; cite the canonical pointer and immutable payload, not this summary, as the publication identity.

## Web applications

- The checked-in [product catalog](https://dappgo.com/config/product-catalog.json) is the canonical map of public routes and store availability.
- [Taiwan stocks Web](https://stocks.dappgo.com/tw/)
- [US stocks Web](https://stocks.dappgo.com/us/)
- [US options Web](https://options.dappgo.com/us/)
- App landing pages: [TW Stocks](https://dappgo.com/tw-stocks/) ([中文](https://dappgo.com/zh/tw-stocks/)), [US Stocks](https://dappgo.com/us-stocks/) ([中文](https://dappgo.com/zh/us-stocks/)), [Options Explorer](https://dappgo.com/options/) ([中文](https://dappgo.com/zh/options/)); each links the App Store, Google Play and web app.
- [DappGo News — Taiwan](https://news.dappgo.com/tw/)
- [DappGo News — United States](https://news.dappgo.com/us/)
- [Market claim verifier](https://hackathon.dappgo.com): Hackathon experiment that checks finance-post numbers against SEC filings and links each checked number to its proof.

## Native app availability

- [Native minimum-version policy](https://dappgo.com/mobile-version-policy.json): schema-v1 minimum supported versions, independently keyed by app and iOS/Android. This is a read-only configuration resource.

- Options Explorer: iOS and Android are available.
- Taiwan Stocks: iOS and Android are available.
- US Stocks: iOS and Android are available.
- Number Merge: Android only (Google Play).

## Website and policies

- [Home — English](https://dappgo.com/): static report snapshot with report dates; research and education only, not investment advice.
- [首頁 — 繁體中文](https://dappgo.com/zh/): 靜態報告摘要附報告日期，僅供研究與學習參考，不構成投資建議。
- [Support](https://dappgo.com/support)

## Limits

Only public read-only resources are advertised. This catalogue grants no login, trading, social publication, Git, SSH or server-operation permission. Native store availability is managed separately. No public MCP or WebMCP action endpoint is advertised. Static Markdown is available at the explicit guide URL; automatic Accept: text/markdown conversion is not enabled.

- [Number RPG](https://dappgo.com/number-rpg/): pet adventure game, available on iOS and Android. Official store downloads, support, privacy, terms, and account deletion are linked from the product page.
